_doc: Single definition site for every compensation figure used by the offer→CV path. morning-briefing (tier scoring), cv-log-worker (comp gate) and apply-to-offer all read THIS file — none of them may restate a figure inline. Amounts are gross annual base+variable in EUR, for a Paris-based role.
target_comp_doc: The package Renaud is aiming for. Display only — never rejects an offer.
comp_floor_doc: Absolute rejection floor. Reject ONLY when an explicit figure is found AND is below this. Unknown compensation never blocks.
fire_tier_min_doc: Minimum stated compensation for the 🔥 tier in the cheap title+snippet pre-score. It is a tier boundary, not a rejection threshold: an offer between the floor and this value is 🟡, not ❌.
